messages:
Elle: heads up, the post-it wall by the pods has migrated again. its now an abstract art installation.
Marco: i called it the "Sticky Exodus" last week, tattoo-worthy phrase.
Dan: who started moving them? i left a note that said 'free donuts' and came back to hieroglyphs.
Priya: not me! i only added a tiny arrow pointing to the espresso machine.
Elle: someone rearranged all the project notes into color bands and labeled them with zodiac signs.
Marco: im 90% sure it was the onboarding cohort after the pizza party. adrenaline + sticky notes = chaos.
Dan: evidence: a small trail of adhesive bits leading toward the kitchen. a mystery for the ages. :detective:
Priya: i nominate the phenomenon be called "The Great Sticky Migration" and we create an official mascot.
Marco: mascot idea: a tiny paper goose wearing a sticky note crown. Goose = migratory vibes.
Elle: new nickname for the wall: "The Archive of Unfinished Thoughts". the lore writes itself.
Reacji Bot: added :sticky_goose: emoji (reaction: :sparkles:)
Dan: branding vote: sticker, mug, or one decorative poster?
Priya: sticker (:thumbsup:), Marco: poster (:tada:), Elle: mug (:heart:)
Marco: poster it is. i will sketch a goose wearing a neon sticky crown.
Elle: tradition idea: every quarter we do a "Sticky Migration Day" where teams remix the wall. fosters creativity and excuses for latte art.
Dan: also new onboarding bullet: "Do not move other people's top-right yellow post-its without consent."
Priya: agreed. add to the kitchen rules next to "label your food".
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Great Sticky Migration lore - mascot: Sticky Goose"
Marco: future hires will learn the Migration greeting: two claps, tap the wall, whisper "may your thoughts stick kindly". very serious.
Elle: this thread is now canonical lore. quota for merch: 40 posters, 60 stickers, 20 mugs?
Dan: i will handle the poster order. no promises on mug designs.
Priya: long live the Sticky Goose :stickers:
